tables.description: Weighted omen of impending doom for a grimdark warband.

result.text: Ashen crows gather on the war banner and refuse to fly.
The watch-bell tolls thirteen; every soldier counts only twelve.
Red snow falls on the march and melts before it touches steel.
An old oath is spoken aloud; the speaker's voice is not their own.
A place is set at the war-feast for one who has not yet died.
The war-drums are struck but make no sound, and the host marches anyway.
A pale hound follows the column at a distance, bigger each night.
Cinders rain upward from the campfires.
White flowers bloom on the graves of the not-yet-buried.
The last candle in the shrine gutters but will not go out.
Something beneath the earth whispers each soldier's true name.
Rust runs like tears down the blades before any blow is struck.
A black sun rises at noon, and no shadow falls.
Every mirror in the camp shows the same empty chair.
Rats abandon the supply wagons in disciplined ranks, carrying nothing.
Fresh footprints ring the camp, but no sentry saw a soul.

tables.description: 2d6 table of grim plague outcomes for a settlement.

result.text: The sickness passes quietly. Two households hang black cloth and say nothing.
A coughing sickness takes hold; half the quarter stays abed and the rest keeps watch.
The gates are sealed from within. No one leaves, and the bell rings each dawn.
The tainted quarter is fired. Ash drifts over the inner wall for a week.
The surviving population flees. Empty streets echo with the sound of open doors.
By the tenth day no voice is raised in the city. The crows have it entirely.
